instruction_ref_zh: 将左起第二把绿椅的梯形靠背可见木框替换为带两根竖条的圆弧形木靠背框。
instruction_noref: Replace the selected chair backrest with a rounded wooden backrest frame with two upright slats.
instruction_noref_zh: 将选中的椅子靠背替换为带两根竖条的圆弧形木靠背框。

ref: the top horizontal backrest rail of the little red chair on the far left
ref_zh: 最左小红椅的顶部横木条
instruction_ref: Remove the top horizontal backrest rail of the little red chair on the far left.
instruction_ref_zh: 移除最左小红椅的顶部横木条。
instruction_noref: Remove the selected chair rail.
instruction_noref_zh: 移除选中的椅子横条。

ref: the seat of the black chair on the far right
ref_zh: 最右黑椅的座面
instruction_ref: Change the color of the seat of the black chair on the far right to dark green.
instruction_ref_zh: 将最右黑椅的座面改为深绿色。
instruction_noref: Change the color of the selected chair seat to dark green.
instruction_noref_zh: 将选中的椅子座面改为深绿色。

ref: the seat of the second brown chair from the right
ref_zh: 右起第二把棕椅的座面
instruction_ref: Add one small cream-colored seat cushion to the seat of the second brown chair from the right.
instruction_ref_zh: 给右起第二把棕椅的座面加上一个米白色小坐垫。
instruction_noref: Add one small cream-colored seat cushion to the selected chair seat.
instruction_noref_zh: 给选中的椅子座面加上一个米白色小坐垫。
